problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{c}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,{c}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,d=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -11 \\ -5\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{c}_{1}+{x}_{2}{c}_{2}=d,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
.

feedback.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}7 \\ 9 \\ 4\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}7 \\ 9 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1} \\ -2{x}_{1} \\ 3{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}7 \\ 9 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} \\ -2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}7 \\ 9 \\ 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=7 \\ -2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=9 \\ 3{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=4\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the third equation by $-1$ and adding the result to the first equation we get 

$$
\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{1} & =7-4 \\ {x}_{1} & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

Now,  we substitute ${x}_{1}=3$ into the third equation to get 

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} & =4 \\ 3(3)-{x}_{2} & =4 \\ -{x}_{2} & =4-9 \\ {x}_{2} & =5.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=3$ and ${x}_{2}=5$ into the second equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} & =9 \\ -2(3)+3(5) & =9 \\ -6+15 & =9,\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement. 

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=3$ and ${x}_{2}=5,$ which means

$$
3{a}_{1}+5{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=3+5=8.
$$
